why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate already differed between the arms before exposure, by about as much as the lift seen after.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: The arms were likely not comparable at the start, so the lift may mostly reflect who was assigned, not the new ranker.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison showing no gap on Successful Search Rate, for example after a re-randomized rerun, would let the call be made from the lift.
A documented cause for the pre-exposure gap, added to the pre-registration, would move this to triage.
A daily effect series by days since first exposure would allow the novelty check to run.
